summary: V50.z541 Supermaster panel + Org plans + Welcome email at registration + FAQ by role — BACKEND ONLY. 31/31 pytest cases passed against localhost:8001. Verified: (A) Super-admin /admin/users list with counts/plans/filters (role=master, status=unverified, q=email), 401 unauth, 403 non-super. (B) Full org-plan flow: 'collab' plan enforces plan_limit (402 code:'plan_limit') on POST /team and POST /invites; /org/plan returns used=1/max=1/left=0 + upgrades; upgrade-request idempotent (second call → already=true); super-admin PATCH /admin/users/{M1} org_plan=master10 then team create succeeds (used=2/max=10). (C) PATCH role→admin, PATCH parent_user_id moves user (auto-becomes admin), self-parent=400, parent=''→owner. (D) DELETE with children→409 code:'has_children'; cascade=1 deletes ≥2; self-delete=400. (E) POST welcome-email: welcome_email_sent_at OR welcome_email_error recorded; POST verify-email flips email_verified=true. (F) /public/org-plans ids collab/master10/master50/enterprise with 19/50/100/null; /admin/org-plans GET/PUT (modify master10 label+price, persists to public), duplicate-id→400, non-quote missing price→400, reset restores defaults. (G) Registration with org_plan='invalid' falls back to 'collab'; welcome fields written at registration (best-effort). (H) /api/billing/plans derives from org plans (collab/master10/master50 with amount 19/50/100, 'org' object present). (I) FAQ by role: anonymous → role=null and NO tagged items; super_admin → role=superadmin and 26 items; master owner → role=master includes faq_17/faq_19 excludes faq_21/22/23; admin user → role=manager includes faq_22 excludes faq_17; /faq/suggest?q='landing page' owner first=faq_17, anonymous excludes it. (J) PUT /landing/cms/faq with X-CMS-Password strips bogus roles (keeps only 'collab'); /landing/cms/faq/reset restores defaults.

minor.issue: Response does NOT include user_id (only {super_admin, email}). Consider adding user_id to the payload — needed by any client that wants to resolve 'me' for admin actions (e.g. self-delete check).

action_items: Consider including user_id in GET /api/admin/me response (minor; otherwise clients must call /admin/users?q=email to resolve themselves).
No code changes required — all V50.z541 features behave as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_users.py `_au_out` relies on module-level `is_super_admin`, `utcnow`, `descendant_user_ids` injected into globals via the loader — flagged by linter (noqa F821). Works at runtime, but fragile if the shared namespace loader changes.

org_plans._org_root_id caps parent chain at 12 levels — safeguard against cycles is sensible, but there's no explicit assertion/log if the ceiling is hit; a very deep (or looping) tree would be silently reported as rooted at the 12th hop.

Registration IP rate limit is 5/h, 12/day. For automated backend testing we had to raise the limits via app_settings.register_guard override and restore defaults after. Confirmed the override path works — mentioned here so future testing agents know how to bypass it quickly without touching code.
seed_data_creation: Created 10+ ephemeral users during tests, all cleaned via DELETE /api/admin/users/{id}?cascade=1 in a terminal cleanup test. Mongo app_settings.register_guard was temporarily relaxed (ip_per_hour=500, ip_per_day=1000, email_per_day=50, min_fill_ms=500) and then DELETED to restore defaults. register_challenges + register_blocked collections were purged before the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses /api/auth/register PoW anti-bot: GET /auth/register/challenge → sha256(prefix+nonce) must start with 'difficulty' zero hex chars (default 4). Must wait min_fill_ms (default 3000) between challenge fetch and register call. IP rate limit (register_guard) is low (5/h, 12/day) — if you need many registrations, override via Mongo `app_settings.key:'register_guard'` with higher ip_per_hour/ip_per_day/email_per_day then delete the override at the end. CMS password for /landing/cms/* is in /app/backend/.env as LANDING_CMS_PASSWORD='axon-cms-2026' and must be sent as X-CMS-Password header. GET /api/admin/me returns only {super_admin, email} — resolve user_id via /admin/users?q=email.
